why.primary_action_salience: All three are equally effective. The solid-filled button vs. text-only controls create clear hierarchy and visual dominance in all variants.
why.control_visibility: All three are identical: primary action button is visually prominent, cancel and edit are findable text actions with clear relative importance.
why.visual_craft: All three have identical spacing rhythm, type hierarchy, button proportions, and optical balance. No meaningful differences.
why.semantic_colour: E740 (orange) is most appropriate for a 'send' action to another app—orange conveys outgoing communication and positive forward motion. E597 and 512A use purple, which is more neutral and generic.
why.overall: E740 wins on semantic color appropriateness. E597 and 512A are visually identical and tied; E740 edges ahead through better color semantics for the send action.

differences: E740: Orange/amber primary button; 'Edit' text is orange-tinted (not gray)
512A: Purple primary button (appears visually identical to E597)
